headline: desired_capacity below min_size makes this configuration invalid and won't achieve the scaling goal

findings.evidence_ref: desired_capacity changed to 1, but min_size remains 3
findings.explanation: AWS ASG requires desired_capacity to fall between min_size and max_size. This configuration is invalid—the ASG will ignore the desired_capacity=1 and maintain at least 3 instances, defeating the cost savings goal. You need to also reduce min_size to 1.
